request.description: The best current value per attribute for a person or business. Ranking: fresh before stale, then ops verified > third-party verified > extracted > derived > declared, then most recent. Facts past `validUntil` are ignored. Special-category values are decrypted for authorised staff only. Staff only. Reading needs party read access (ops lead, compliance, support); recording needs party update access (ops lead, super admin). `partyId` comes from a lead or user record.

response.name: 200 OK
